headline: AquaUrsa Research moves to 13th on ARC-3

sections.text: AquaUrsa Research gained 0.72 to reach 39.69, moving from 15th to 13th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The move puts AquaUrsa inside the board's 18 gold places; the 18th-place cutoff is 38.20.
